items.title: Poonawalla Fincorp Q2 profit surges fivefold as income rises
items.description: Poonawalla Fincorp reported a substantial increase in net profit for the second quarter, rising over fivefold. The company's net interest income and fee income grew significantly, contributing to the profit surge. New loan products accounted for a notable percentage of disbursements during this period, demonstrating the diversification of their offerings. Additionally, improvements in the gross non-performing asset ratio reflect better asset quality management.

items.title: Poonawalla Fincorp Q2 Results: Profit skyrockets 407% YoY to Rs 375 crore, NII rises 81%
items.description: Poonawalla Fincorp reported a 407% year-on-year surge in Q2FY27 profit to Rs 375 crore, while net interest income rose 81%. Operating profit more than doubled, supported by business growth, improving asset quality and an expanded gold loan network.

items.title: Anand Rathi Wealth Q2 Results: Profit rises 22% to Rs 122 crore; co declares dividend of Rs 4 per share
items.description: Anand Rathi Wealth reported a 22% year-on-year rise in Q2 business profit to Rs 122 crore, with revenue increasing 16%. Assets under management reached Rs 1.08 lakh crore as quarterly net inflows hit a record Rs 4,186 crore.
